title: The Outer Worlds 2 first DLC lands December 2 🧪
subject: outerworlds2
description:
Will you help Sub Rosa or cross them? 👇

Obsidian's first story expansion for The Outer Worlds 2, Side Effects Guaranteed, launches December 2, 2026 for $14.99 or with the Premium Edition. It adds Elysium Valley on Eden, a level cap of 36, 15 perks and 4 flaws. Part two arrives in spring 2027.

Sources: Xbox Wire (Nov 10, 2026), VGC (Nov 10, 2026), Gematsu (Nov 2026)
Game footage © Obsidian Entertainment / Xbox Game Studios.

scenes.text: The Outer Worlds 2 has its first story expansion.
Side Effects Guaranteed arrives December 2 for $14.99.
A distress signal leads your crew to a derelict ship, where frozen thieves need a cure.
That hunt runs through Sub Rosa agent Gordon Hazen to Elysium Valley, a new region on Eden.
The level cap rises from 30 to 36, with 15 new perks, four flaws and a radio station with 20 songs.
Part two lands in spring 2027, and your choices carry over.
